bio.text: Lori Den Hartog is a Republican who represents District 22 in the Idaho Senate and is listed in a sixth term; the legislature's directory lists Den Hartog's occupation as homemaker.
The directory lists Den Hartog as the Senate's Majority Leader.
According to the legislature's biography, Den Hartog graduated from Nampa Christian High School and holds a B.A. in business administration/public administration from Dordt University.
